claim: A Journal of Immunology EAE study reported that HLA-DRA1 constructs blocked CD74 expression and MIF effects in experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis.
future_grounding_route: Use only as segregated mechanistic animal-model context unless project-held perturbation or MS immune data are used to test HLA-DR/CD74/MIF coupling directly.
project_use: Sharper external context linking HLA-DR, CD74, MIF, and CNS autoimmune model biology around the coupled APC-axis hypothesis.
relationship_note: This supports mechanistic plausibility of HLA-DR/CD74/MIF coupling in an EAE model, but it does not directly validate the human MS coupled-axis structure.

source.citation: Vandenbark et al. HLA-DRA1 constructs block CD74 expression and MIF effects in experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis. Journal of Immunology. 2014.
source.label: J Immunol HLA-DRA1/CD74/MIF EAE study

source_terms.license_or_terms_label: PubMed bibliographic metadata and short paraphrase only
source_terms.reuse_notes: V50 stores bibliographic metadata and a short paraphrased claim only; do not redistribute article text or treat it as project-grounded evidence.

why_unverifiable: The project has not rerun the external animal-model experiment or reproduced it in held human MS data.
